 PAWBench: How Far Are We from
Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?

Yuandong Pu    Le Zhuo    Sayak Paul    Gabriel Jorge Menezes ††thanks: This work was done during his internship at Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University     Affiliation: Shanghai AI Laboratory     Affiliation:  Krea AI    Affiliation: Huggingface        Avram Đorđević    Shiyang Li    Yifan Zhou    Bin Fu    Wenlong Zhang Affiliation: Shanghai Jiao Tong University     Affiliation: Shanghai AI Laboratory     Affiliation:  Krea AI       Junjun He    Qiao Yu    Yihao Liu    Jinbo Xing    Xi Chen† ††thanks: Corresponding Authors Affiliation: Shanghai AI Laboratory     Affiliation: Shanghai Innovation Institute     Affiliation: Tongyi Lab     Affiliation:  The University of Hong Kong    
Abstract

Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model’s predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.

Project page: https://pawbench.github.io

1 Introduction

Recent advances in video generation have substantially improved instruction following, visual quality, and temporal coherence (Google, 2025; Kling AI, 2026; ByteDance Seed, 2026b; Lightricks, 2026b; MiniMax, 2026). Given an observation and a prompt or action-like control signal, current systems can generate plausible continuations of a scene. Together, these advances (OpenAI, 2024; Google DeepMind, 2025a; Agarwal et al., 2026) have strengthened the case for viewing video generators not only as content creation tools, but also as visual world models.

Yet a world model must do more than render visually plausible rollouts. Because an observation reveals only part of the world state and an action does not specify all of its consequences, the generated rollouts must remain consistent with the scene’s underlying geometry and dynamics (Li and World Labs Team, 2026). When the underlying process is stochastic, the same initial observation and action can admit multiple physically valid futures rather than a single correct continuation (Babaeizadeh et al., 2018; Denton and Fergus, 2018). A model should therefore capture the conditional distribution over these futures, not merely render one plausible sample. We call this requirement probabilistic alignment: under a fixed initial observation and action, the induced distribution should reflect both which futures are physically possible and how likely each one is. Probabilistic alignment matters for interaction and planning (Ravi et al., 2025), because decisions depend on both the possible consequences of an action and their relative likelihoods.

Evaluation, however, still treats generated videos as isolated outputs rather than samples from the conditional distribution induced by the model. Existing benchmarks evaluate each generated video independently along dimensions of visual quality, temporal coherence, text or action alignment, and physical plausibility (Huang et al., 2024a; Huang et al., 2024b; Bansal et al., 2024; Li et al., 2025)。然而，在相同的初始观察和行动下，这些标准的成功并不能揭示模型在可能的未来的潜在分布。模型仍然可能产生看似合理的单个视频，但会崩溃为有效结果的狭窄子集或以错误的比例分配概率质量。如图所示. Yet success on these criteria does not reveal the model’s underlying distribution over possible futures given the same initial observation and action. A model may still produce plausible individual videos while collapsing to a narrow subset of valid outcomes or assigning probability mass in the wrong proportions. As illustrated in Fig.1，因此，一个合理的未来是不够的。这就留下了一个核心问题：, one plausible future is therefore not enough. This leaves a central question:我们离概率一致的世界建模还有多远？how far are we from probabilistically aligned world modeling?

我们在 PAWBench 上对 11 个当前视频生成模型进行了基准测试。没有任何模型能够满足所有三个要求：准确的结果概率、有效未来的广泛覆盖以及跨场景的可靠性能。更多的测试支持了主要评估中使用的采样预算，而 PAWEval 同意人类对具有明确最终结果的视频的判断。受控干预表明，当物理转变发生变化时，模型分布变化太小，但当只有非因果线索发生变化时，模型分布就会发生变化。因此，当前的视频生成器距离概率对齐的世界建模还很远：即使它们的底层分布错过了有效的未来并为它们分配了错误的概率，单个视频也可能看起来似乎合理。We benchmark eleven current video generation models on PAWBench. No model achieves all three requirements: accurate outcome probabilities, broad coverage of valid futures, and reliable performance across scenes. Tests with more rollouts support the sampling budget used in the main evaluation, while PAWEval agrees with human judgments on videos with clear terminal outcomes. Controlled interventions show that model distributions change too little when the physical transition changes, yet can shift when only a non-causal cue changes. Current video generators therefore remain far from probabilistically aligned world modeling: individual videos may look plausible even when their underlying distributions miss valid futures and assign them the wrong probabilities.

接下来，我们从测量概率对齐转向询问是否可以改进。我们检查了三个干预点，从明确的语言，通过初始噪声采样，到模型在相同的初始观察和行动下学习的预测分布。语言使可能的未来变得明确：VLM 预测可能发生的事情，而提示则引导视频生成器走向指定的未来。采样使未来变得不确定，并改变初始噪声，以暴露同一生成器的更广泛的可能性。微调会改变模型本身，测试它是否能够了解可能的未来概率如何随身体状态而变化。We next move from measuring probabilistic alignment to asking whether it can be improved. We examine three points of intervention, moving from explicit language, through initial noise sampling, to the model’s learned predictive distribution under the same initial observation and action. Language makes possible futures explicit: VLMs predict what may happen, while prompts guide a video generator toward a named future. Sampling leaves the future unspecified and varies the initial noise to expose a broader range of possibilities from the same generator. Fine-tuning changes the model itself, testing whether it can learn how the probabilities of possible futures should vary with physical state.

这种划分区分了单样本评估无法区分的两个故障 区分。 PAW 校准测量概率错配：每次推出都可能显示看似合理的骰子滚动或旋转器运动，但一种结果可能出现得太频繁。 PAW-Coverage 衡量缺失的结果：即使某些有效的未来从未出现，个别推出可能看起来似乎合理。因此，我们单独报告校准和覆盖范围，而不是将它们合并为一个 得分。This division separates two failures that single-sample evaluation cannot distinguish. PAW-Calibration measures probability misallocation: every rollout may show a plausible die roll or spinner motion, yet one outcome may occur far too often. PAW-Coverage measures missing outcomes: individual rollouts may look plausible even though some valid futures never appear. We therefore report calibration and coverage separately rather than combine them into a single score.

3.2 场景策划Scenario Curation

PAWBench 依赖于重复推出统计数据，因此每个场景都必须明确定义诱导的未来分布。因此，我们围绕三个要求策划场景。首先，随机性必须源自可见的物理机制，而不是源自行动提示的模糊性或隐藏的初始条件。其次，动作提示必须指定一个原子干预，其完成可以从生成的视频中判断。第三，最终结果必须形成一个有限的、视觉上可区分的集合，以便部署可以一致地映射到PAWBench relies on repeated-rollout statistics, so each scenario must make the induced future distribution well defined. We therefore curate scenarios around three requirements. First, stochasticity must arise from a visible physical mechanism, rather than from ambiguity in the action prompt or hidden initial conditions. Second, the action prompt must specify one atomic intervention whose completion can be judged from the generated video. Third, the terminal outcomes must form a finite, visually distinguishable set so that rollouts can be consistently mapped into𝒴\mathcal{Y}。我们根据这些要求手动策划和审查 50 个场景中的每一个。. We manually curate and review each of the 50 scenarios against these requirements.

We list the valid terminal outcomes and specify when a rollout fails to complete the intended physical process. For PAW-Calibration, we also derive a reference distribution from analytic reasoning or physical symmetry. We review and finalize the source image, action prompt, outcome set, failure criteria, and reference distribution before evaluating any model. PAW-Coverage instead measures valid-support recovery as the fraction of valid outcomes observed across repeated rollouts. Both metrics use readable, in-schema outcomes; the outcome-readout gate separately determines whether a scene is scoreable. AppendixB提供完整的指标 用于计算报告结果的定义、门和聚合规则。provides the full metric definitions, gate, and aggregation rules used to compute the reported results.

4 PAWBench 评估Evaluation on PAWBench

4.1 评估设置Evaluation Setup

我们在 PAW-Calibration 和 PAW-Coverage 上评估了 11 个当前视频生成模型，如表 1 中所列。We evaluate eleven current video generation models on both PAW-Calibration and PAW-Coverage, as listed in Tab.1。该名单涵盖专有和公开发布的系统：HappyHorse. The roster spans proprietary and openly released systems: HappyHorse(Alibaba Cloud, 2026a), Veo3.1 快速, Veo3.1 Fast(Google, 2025)，克林 3 标准。, Kling 3 Std.(Kling AI, 2026), 种子舞会 2, Seedance 2(ByteDance Seed, 2026a)、万2.7, Wan2.7(Alibaba Cloud, 2026b)、万2.2, Wan2.2(Wan Team, 2025),LTX-2.3, LTX-2.3(Lightricks, 2026a),LTX-2.5, LTX-2.5(HaCohen et al., 2026; Lightricks, 2026b), Cosmos 3 超级 I2V, Cosmos 3 Super I2V(NVIDIA, 2025; Agarwal et al., 2026), LingBot-视频-教育部, LingBot-Video-MoE(Ma et al., 2026)和 MiniMax H3, and MiniMax H3(MiniMax, 2026)。对于每个 PAWBench 场景，所有系统都会收到相同的源图像和操作提示。在主要评估中，我们抽样. For each PAWBench scenario, all systems receive the same source image and action prompt. In the main evaluation, we sampleK=50K=50每个场景和系统都有独立的推出，并且操作提示在整个推出过程中保持固定。除非另有说明，我们使用每个系统的默认推理配置。当场景的 50 次滚动中不超过 30 次时，场景就会通过结果读出门 结果读出失败，相当于至少 20 个产生可读、模式内的结果 结果。我们将场景通过率 (SPR) 报告为每个轨道中 25 个场景的百分比 通过这个门的人。independent rollouts per scenario and system, with the action prompt held fixed across rollouts. Unless otherwise specified, we use each system with its default inference configuration. A scene passes the outcome-readout gate when no more than 30 of its 50 rollouts fail outcome readout, equivalently when at least 20 yield readable, in-schema outcomes. We report Scene Pass Rate (SPR) as the percentage of the 25 scenes in each track that pass this gate.

4.2 基准测试结果Benchmark Results

当前的视频生成器距离概率对齐的世界建模还很远。Current video generators remain far from probabilistically aligned world modeling.如表所示。As shown in Tab.1，没有任何模型能够将良好对齐的概率质量、广泛的支持恢复和跨场景的可靠性能结合起来。 Cosmos 3 Super I2V 实现了最低的校准 TVD，但只有 80.0% 的校准场景通过了结果读出门。 LTX-2.3 获得了最高的覆盖率平均值，但该平均值是根据其通过的覆盖率场景的 72.0% 计算得出的。相反，Seedance 2 和 LingBot-Video-MoE 分别在校准和覆盖范围上通过了每个场景，但都没有领先于相应的条件指标。因此，条件对齐和场景级可靠性抓住了当前模型的明显局限性，必须一起阅读。, no model combines well-aligned probability mass, broad support recovery, and reliable performance across scenes. Cosmos 3 Super I2V achieves the lowest Calibration TVD, but only 80.0% of its Calibration scenes pass the outcome-readout gate. LTX-2.3 attains the highest Coverage average, yet that average is computed over the 72.0% of its Coverage scenes that pass. Conversely, Seedance 2 and LingBot-Video-MoE pass every scene on Calibration and Coverage, respectively, but neither leads the corresponding conditional metric. Conditional alignment and scene-level reliability therefore capture distinct limitations of current models and must be read together.

恢复有效的期货并不等同于为它们分配正确的概率。Recovering valid futures is not the same as assigning them the right probability.恢复广泛支持的模型并不是那些与参考概率最匹配的模型，并且这种分离在物理机制中持续存在。生成器可能会暴露许多看似合理的结果，同时错误地分配概率质量，或者与观察到的结果的频率紧密匹配，但无法看到有效的替代方案。因此，PAW-Coverage 和 PAW-Calibration 暴露了互补的失败：恢复有效支持是必要的，但它并不能确定概率质量在该支持内的结果之间正确分配。The models that recover broad support are not those that best match the reference probabilities, and this separation persists across physical mechanisms. A generator may expose many plausible outcomes while allocating probability mass incorrectly, or closely match the frequencies of observed outcomes while leaving valid alternatives unseen. PAW-Coverage and PAW-Calibration therefore expose complementary failures: recovering the valid support is necessary, but it does not establish that probability mass is correctly allocated among the outcomes within that support.

模型不能一致地区分因果变化和非因果变化。Models Do Not Consistently Distinguish Causal from Non-Causal Changes.概率世界模型应该仅在物理转变发生变化时才改变其未来分布。我们用配对干预来测试这个标准：物理因果干预改变了转变及其参考分布，而非因果干预仅改变不相关的视觉或文本信号，因此应该保持物理过程及其未来分布不变。A probabilistic world model should change its future distribution only when the physical transition changes. We test this criterion with paired interventions: physically causal interventions alter the transition and its reference distribution, whereas non-causal interventions change only an irrelevant visual or textual signal and should therefore leave both the physical process and its future distribution unchanged.

如图所示。As shown in Fig.4，在物理因果干预下，模型分布不完全移动或朝错误方向移动。在非因果干预下，尽管参考分布不变，干扰文本仍会重定向概率质量。附录, model distributions shift incompletely or in the wrong direction under physically causal interventions. Under non-causal interventions, distractor text redirects probability mass despite an unchanged reference distribution. AppendixB.5报告所有配对控件、视频生成器和直接 VLM 未来采样器的相同模式。模型对改变的输入做出响应，但它们的响应不能可靠地跟踪潜在的物理转变是否发生了变化。reports the same pattern across all paired controls, video generators, and direct VLM future samplers. Models respond to altered inputs, but their responses do not reliably track whether the underlying physical transition has changed.

5 走向概率对齐的世界建模Toward Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling

创造一个合理的未来，或者甚至控制产生哪个未来，并不等于控制未来的分配。一个概率一致的世界模型必须在固定的初始观察和行动下保留可能结果的随机结构。对于用作世界模型的视频生成器，该分布可能会在三个层面上受到影响：Generating one plausible future, or even controlling which future is produced, does not amount to controlling a distribution of futures. A probabilistically aligned world model must instead preserve the stochastic structure of possible outcomes under a fixed initial observation and action. For a video generator used as a world model, this distribution can be influenced at three levels:及时工程prompt engineering, 初始噪声采样initial noise sampling, 和, and更新模型参数updating model parameters，如图所示, as summarized in Fig.6。因此，我们在可以塑造这种分布的三个界面进行干预：语言指定所请求的未来，初始噪声采样在未来中进行选择，模型学习确定概率质量如何在它们之间分配。这些探针将推理时间引导和有限预算探索与模型本身如何在未来结果上分配概率质量的变化区分开来。. We therefore intervene at three interfaces that can shape this distribution: language specifies a requested future, initial noise sampling selects among futures, and model learning determines how probability mass is allocated among them. These probes distinguish inference-time steering and finite-budget exploration from changes in how the model itself distributes probability mass over future outcomes.

5.1 及时工程Prompt Engineering

语言可以通过在提示中命名未来来控制视频生成器。如果一个模型已经可以呈现几个看似合理的未来，那么在推出过程中改变这些请求可能会重塑其输出分布。因此，我们评估这两个要求：语言控制器是否选择具有所需频率或支持的未来，以及生成器是否实现每个选定的未来。Language can steer a video generator by naming a future in its prompt. If a model can already render several plausible futures, varying these requests across rollouts could reshape its output distribution. We therefore evaluate both requirements: whether the language controller selects futures with the required frequencies or support, and whether the generator realizes each selected future.

我们测试三种设置。首先，先前的工作发现，语言模型通常比通过重复采样再现目标分布更准确地理解或描述目标分布，尽管分布感知提示和训练可以缩小这一差距We test three settings. First, prior work finds that language models often understand or describe a target distribution more accurately than they reproduce it through repeated sampling, although distribution-aware prompting and training can narrow this gap(Meister et al., 2025; Gu et al., 2025; Misaki and Akiba, 2025; Sorensen et al., 2026)。因此，我们询问 VLM 是否可以在没有给出目标概率的情况下充当可能的未来的采样器。我们重复查询五个VLM. We therefore ask whether VLMs can act as samplers over possible futures without being given the target probabilities. We repeatedly query five VLMs(Qwen Team, 2026; OpenAI, 2026b; Z.AI, 2026; Moonshot AI, 2026; Google DeepMind, 2026)在相同的初始观察和行动下，将每个预测映射到 PAWBench 结果空间，并将预测聚合成经验分布。其次，GPT-5.5 为每次部署执行提示工程 (PE)：在不访问参考分布的情况下，它会预测可能的结果并编写一个生成器提示来请求该结果。第三，对于 Oracle PE，我们直接在每个生成器提示中指定一个目标结果，跨部署排列目标以遵循 PAW-Calibration 中的参考分布，并平衡 PAW-Coverage 中的有效结果。这些设置共同区分了两个错误来源：预测结果的错误分布以及未能在视频中产生所需的结果。直接 VLM 未来抽样测试第一个，PE 评估整个链，Oracle PE 直接提供目标结果以隔离第二个。under the same initial observation and action, map each prediction to the PAWBench outcome space, and aggregate the predictions into an empirical distribution. Second, GPT-5.5 performs prompt engineering (PE) for each rollout: without access to the reference distribution, it predicts a possible outcome and writes a generator prompt requesting that outcome. Third, for Oracle PE, we directly specify one target outcome in each generator prompt, arranging the targets across rollouts to follow the reference distribution in PAW-Calibration and to balance the valid outcomes in PAW-Coverage. Together, these settings separate two sources of error: predicting the wrong distribution of outcomes and failing to produce a requested outcome in video. Direct VLM future sampling tests the first, PE evaluates the full chain, and Oracle PE supplies the target outcomes directly to isolate the second.

直接 VLM 采样产生的分布已经不对齐。标签。The distributions produced by direct VLM sampling are already misaligned. Tab.5.1显示 GLM-5V Turbo 实现了最低的校准 TVD，为 34.8，而 Gemini 3.5 Flash 实现了最高的覆盖率，为 46.6%。 GPT-5.5 为 PE 选择的结果在视频生成之前也存在偏差，表 1 中的校准 TVD 得分为 44.3，覆盖率为 35.0%。shows that GLM-5V Turbo achieves the lowest Calibration TVD at 34.8, while Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves the highest Coverage at 46.6%. The outcomes selected by GPT-5.5 for PE are also misaligned before video generation, scoring 44.3 Calibration TVD and 35.0% Coverage in Tab.5.1。将这些选择传递给视频生成器会提高所有四个模型的 SPR，但会增加每种情况下经过的场景之间的校准 TVD，并且仅提高两个模型的覆盖范围。手动指定的目标性能更好：Oracle PE 降低了校准 TVD 并提高了每台发电机的覆盖范围。即使有这些目标，图. Passing these selections to video generators raises SPR for all four models, but increases Calibration TVD among passing scenes in every case and improves Coverage for only two. Manually specified targets perform better: Oracle PE lowers Calibration TVD and raises Coverage for every generator. Even with these targets, Fig.7结果表明，生成器仅实现了 37.6-58.1% 的要求结果。当前基于语言的控制受到两个错误的限制：控制器选择错误的期货分布，而生成器经常错过提供的目标。它可以改变单独的部署，而无需可靠地调整其分布。shows that the generators realize only 37.6–58.1% of the requested outcomes. Current language-based control is limited by both errors: the controller selects the wrong distribution of futures, and the generators often miss the supplied target. It can change individual rollouts without reliably aligning their distribution.

5.2 初始噪声采样Initial Noise Sampling

语言干预会改变所请求的未来，但当请求本身固定时，可以恢复哪些内容。因此，我们从语言转向采样：噪声决定了在相同的要求下会达到哪个未来。保持动作提示和生成器固定，我们测试观察到的间隙的一部分是否是有限样本探索失败，其中独立抽签重复访问相同的模式，即使其他有效结果仍然可访问。The language interventions change which future is requested, but leave open what can be recovered when the request itself is held fixed. We therefore turn from language to sampling: noise determines which future is reached under the same request. Holding the action prompt and generator fixed, we test whether part of the observed gap is a finite-sample exploration failure, in which independent draws repeatedly visit the same modes even when other valid outcomes remain accessible.

我们采用耦合控制（C2C）We adopt Couple to Control (C2C)(Jia et al., 2026)，一种排斥高斯耦合方案，在, a repulsive Gaussian coupling scheme that introduces negative dependence among theK=50K=50初始噪声样本，同时保留每个样本的标准高斯边际。行动提示、生成器和部署预算在 C2C 和独立采样中保持固定；附录initial-noise samples while preserving each sample’s standard Gaussian marginal. The action prompt, generator, and rollout budget remain fixed across C2C and independent sampling; AppendixD.2详细介绍了耦合噪声结构以及用于隔离噪声耦合影响的匹配评估条件。details the coupled-noise construction and the matched evaluation conditions used to isolate the effect of noise coupling.

标签。Tab.5.2报告每个 PAWBench 轨道中所有 25 个场景的结果。在每种条件下通过的场景中，C2C 降低了所有三个发生器的平均校准 TVD 并提高了平均覆盖率。不同机制的收益各不相同，并且不会持续提高 SPR。因此，C2C 帮助 50 次部署更广泛地探索模型现有的可能性，而不是改变模型学习到的分布。因此，我们接下来转向模型本身。reports results across all 25 scenes in each PAWBench track. Across the scenes that pass in each condition, C2C lowers mean Calibration TVD and raises mean Coverage for all three generators. The gains vary across mechanisms and do not consistently raise SPR. C2C therefore helps the 50 rollouts explore the model’s existing possibilities more broadly, rather than changing the distribution learned by the model. We therefore turn next to the model itself.

6 相关工作Related Work

作为世界模型的视频生成器。Video Generators as World Models.

世界模型长期以来一直被用来通过预测行动的后果来支持规划，从基于经典模型的强化学习到潜在动态和以决策为中心的模型World models have long been used to support planning by predicting the consequences of actions, from classical model-based reinforcement learning to latent dynamics and decision-centric models(Sutton, 1990; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2020; Schrittwieser et al., 2020)。最近的视频系统越来越多地通过可控的视觉展示来发挥这一作用，包括大规模视频生成器和交互式世界模型. Recent video systems increasingly pursue this role through controllable visual rollouts, including large-scale video generators and interactive world models(OpenAI, 2024; Bruce et al., 2024; Google DeepMind, 2025a; NVIDIA, 2025; Yang et al., 2024)。这种转变使得从相同的初始观察和行动中重复推出变得很自然。 PAWBench 重点关注这些系统留下的分布问题：不仅是部署是否连贯、可控或视觉真实，而且诱导的样本是否将概率质量放在正确的未来上。. This shift makes repeated rollouts from the same initial observation and action natural. PAWBench focuses on the distributional question left open by these systems: not only whether a rollout is coherent, controllable, or visually realistic, but whether the induced samples place probability mass on the right futures.

视频生成和世界模型基准。Video-generation and world-model benchmarks.

视频生成基准大大改进了对视觉质量、时间一致性和文本视频对齐的评估Video-generation benchmarks have substantially improved evaluation of visual quality, temporal consistency, and text-video alignment(Liu et al., 2024; Huang et al., 2024a; Huang et al., 2024b)。以物理为中心的基准进一步探讨物理合理性和行动跟踪. Physics-focused benchmarks further probe physical plausibility and action following(Bansal et al., 2024; Meng et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025; Sanli et al., 2025; Pu et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026)。最近的世界模型基准评估了行动条件预测、物理定律遵守、体现一致性或下游规划和控制效用. Recent world-model benchmarks evaluate action-conditioned prediction, physical-law adherence, embodied consistency, or downstream utility for planning and control(Li et al., 2025; Qin et al., 2025; Kang et al., 2024; Tian et al., 2023)。这些评估是对 PAWBench 的补充，但它们的分析单位通常是个体生成、确定性违规或提示下的任务成功。 PAWBench 相反，固定初始观察和操作，对重复的推出进行采样，将它们映射到终端结果标签，并评估经验结果分布或支持是否与场景的随机结构匹配。. These evaluations are complementary to PAWBench, but their unit of analysis is usually an individual generation, a deterministic violation, or task success under a prompt. PAWBench instead holds the initial observation and action fixed, samples repeated rollouts, maps them to terminal outcome labels, and evaluates whether the empirical outcome distribution or support matches the stochastic structure of the scene.

固定动作下的校准和覆盖。Calibration and coverage under fixed actions.

校准和分布评估将准确性、保真度、概率分配和支持恢复分开Calibration and distributional evaluation separate accuracy, fidelity, probability assignment, and support recovery(Guo et al., 2017; Nalisnick et al., 2019; Sajjadi et al., 2018; Kynkäanniemi et al., 2019; Naeem et al., 2020)。最近关于生成视频不确定性的工作也表明置信度估计是可行且重要的. Recent work on generative-video uncertainty also shows that confidence estimation is feasible and important(Mei et al., 2025a; Mei et al., 2025b)。最接近我们的设置的是，CaliBench 使用已知的参考分布评估九个随机场景，分别报告条件 TVD 的可评分性并测试校准错误. Closest to our setting, CaliBench evaluates nine stochastic scenes with known reference distributions, reporting scorability separately from conditional TVD and testing for miscalibration(Sadeghi et al., 2026)。 PAWBench 共享重复推出、离散结果的观点，但区分了两种制度：当可防御的参考概率可用时，PAW 校准；当只能指定有效支持时，PAW 覆盖。它将这些测量结果与因果状态、语言、采样噪声和训练分布的受控探针进一步配对。. PAWBench shares the repeated-rollout, discrete-outcome perspective but separates two regimes: PAW-Calibration when defensible reference probabilities are available, and PAW-Coverage when only the valid support can be specified. It further pairs these measurements with controlled probes of causal state, language, sampling noise, and training distribution.

7 局限性Limitations

PAWBench 被设计为概率对齐的诊断测试，其当前形式具有三个主要局限性。首先，它通过最终结果评估随机未来，这使得分布比较易于处理，但不能完全捕获轨迹级动态或中间物理过程。其次，它的估计是基于有限数量的推出：较大的抽样预算可以更可靠地揭示诱导分布，但它们会增加评估成本，并且本身并不能纠正有偏差的模型分布。第三，PAWBench 使用受控的、视觉上可解析的场景来隔离随机的未来建模，为未来的研究留下更长远的、交互式的和具体的环境。未来的工作应该将概率对齐从终端标签扩展到更丰富的状态轨迹，研究更高效、更可靠的基于推出的估计器，将基准扩展到交互式设置，并为模型制定训练目标，以明确学习不同物理状态下可能的未来的校准分布。PAWBench is designed as a diagnostic test of probabilistic alignment, and its current form has three main limitations. First, it evaluates stochastic futures through terminal outcomes, which makes distributional comparison tractable but does not fully capture trajectory-level dynamics or intermediate physical processes. Second, its estimates are based on a finite number of rollouts: larger sampling budgets can reveal the induced distribution more reliably, but they increase evaluation cost and do not by themselves correct biased model distributions. Third, PAWBench uses controlled, visually parseable scenarios to isolate stochastic future modeling, leaving longer-horizon, interactive, and embodied environments for future study. Future work should extend probabilistic alignment from terminal labels to richer state trajectories, study more efficient and reliable rollout-based estimators, scale the benchmark to interactive settings, and develop training objectives for models that explicitly learn calibrated distributions over possible futures across different physical states.

8 结论Conclusion

世界建模需要的不仅仅是产生合理的延续；一个世界 模型应该捕捉相同条件下可能的未来的分布 初步观察和行动。我们引入PAWBench来提出这个要求 可通过重复视频推出来衡量。跨越十一个当前视频 生成器，没有模型始终匹配参考概率，而 恢复有效期货的范围，并且差距不能解释为 有限抽样或与人类对明确结果的判断存在分歧。 受控干预进一步表明模型分布并不可靠 跟踪物理过程中的因果变化。语言可以要求个人 未来，耦合噪声可以扩大有限预算探索和微调 可以改变结果频率，但没有一个能够可靠地恢复 对可能的未来进行场景条件分布。因此 PAWBench 显示 合理的、多样化的或可控的部署本身并不 建立跨不同物理的概率一致的世界模型 州。World modeling requires more than producing plausible continuations; a world model should capture the distribution of possible futures under the same initial observation and action. We introduce PAWBench to make this requirement measurable through repeated video rollouts. Across eleven current video generators, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid futures, and the gap cannot be explained by finite sampling or disagreement with human judgments on clear outcomes. Controlled interventions further show that model distributions do not reliably track causal changes in the physical process. Language can request individual futures, coupled noise can broaden finite-budget exploration, and fine-tuning can shift outcome frequencies, but none reliably recovers the scene-conditioned distribution over possible futures. PAWBench therefore shows that plausible, diverse, or controllable rollouts do not by themselves establish probabilistically aligned world modeling across different physical states.

A.1 场景定义和任务分类Scenario Definition and Task Taxonomy

每个 PAWBench 场景都修复了一次重复部署的输入和结果 测试，如表所示。Each PAWBench scenario fixes the inputs and outcomes of one repeated-rollout test, as shown in Tab.6。源图像 表示初始观察，操作提示指定一个原子 干预和有限的结果集. A source image represents the initial observation, an action prompt specifies one atomic intervention, and a finite outcome set𝒴\mathcal{Y}列出有效终端 物理过程的结果。每个场景还包括结果读数 标准，并且当它可以独立于模型输出导出时， 参考分布lists the valid terminal outcomes of the physical process. Each scenario also includes outcome-readout criteria and, when it can be derived independently of model outputs, a reference distributionqq结束over𝒴\mathcal{Y}。我们之前最终确定了这些要素 评估任何模型。. We finalize these elements before evaluating any model.

A.1.1 PAW 校准任务PAW-Calibration Tasks

PAW 校准包含其参考分布的场景PAW-Calibration comprises scenarios whose reference distributionqq是固定的 在模型评估之前。我们得出is fixed before model evaluation. We deriveqq从部门比例来看，组合 结果计数、物理对称性或可见的因果状态——不是来自模型 输出或默认的统一假设。当初步观察和 动作不支持可防御的参考分布，场景是 分配给 PAW-Coverage 或丢弃。 PAW-Calibration测试是否重复 rollouts 根据以下条件分配概率质量from sector proportions, combinatorial outcome counts, physical symmetry, or visible causal state—not from model outputs or a default uniform assumption. When the initial observation and action do not support a defensible reference distribution, the scenario is assigned to PAW-Coverage or discarded. PAW-Calibration tests whether repeated rollouts allocate probability mass in accordance withqq.

A.1.2 PAW 覆盖任务PAW-Coverage Tasks

PAW-Coverage 包括其有效最终结果可以是的场景 已列举，但其相对概率不能从 初步观察和行动。它测试重复的支持恢复 在不假设相同结果概率的情况下推出。PAW-Coverage comprises scenarios whose valid terminal outcomes can be enumerated but whose relative probabilities cannot be justified from the initial observation and action. It tests support recovery across repeated rollouts without assuming equal outcome probabilities.

A.2 场景构建和质量审查Scenario Construction and Quality Review

我们构建每个场景，以便重复推出的变化反映 模型的未来分布而不是基准项中的模糊性。 在评估之前，我们最终确定源图像、操作提示、有效终端 结果、参考分布（适用时）以及结果读数标准。 物理机制必须是可见的，动作必须指定一个 干预，并且最终结果必须是可区分的。We construct each scenario so that variation across repeated rollouts reflects the model’s future distribution rather than ambiguity in the benchmark item. Before evaluation, we finalize the source image, action prompt, valid terminal outcomes, reference distribution when applicable, and outcome-readout criteria. The physical mechanism must be visible, the action must specify one intervention, and the terminal outcomes must be distinguishable.

源图像选择。Source-image selection.对于每个场景，我们生成候选 具有图像生成模型的源图像For each scenario, we generate candidate source images with image generation models(Google DeepMind, 2025b; OpenAI, 2026a)并手动选择一张图像。所选图像必须清楚地显示 相关的物理机制和动作目标，避免隐藏的初始条件， 并支持可与最终帧区分开来的最终结果。 我们拒绝具有模糊机制、模糊初始状态的候选者， 或竞争的行动目标。and manually select one image. The selected image must clearly show the relevant physical mechanism and action target, avoid hidden initial conditions, and support terminal outcomes that can be distinguished from the final frames. We reject candidates with an obscured mechanism, an ambiguous initial state, or competing action targets.

场景最终确定。Scenario finalization.给定选定的源图像，我们编写一个 指定一个原子干预的操作提示，其完成可以是 从生成的视频判断。然后我们定义有效的最终结果， 可读模式内标签的标准，以及单独的可信度检查。 对于 PAW 校准，我们仅在分析时保留参考分布 推理或物理对称性证明它的合理性与模型输出无关。 结果类别描述了最终的物理状态而不是偶然的 外观或中间轨迹的差异。Given the selected source image, we write an action prompt that specifies one atomic intervention whose completion can be judged from the generated video. We then define the valid terminal outcomes, criteria for readable in-schema labels, and separate trustworthiness checks. For PAW-Calibration, we retain a reference distribution only when analytic reasoning or physical symmetry justifies it independently of model outputs. Outcome categories describe terminal physical states rather than incidental differences in appearance or intermediate trajectories.

质量审查。Quality review.我们之前将每个候选者作为一个完整的场景进行审查 评估任何模型。审查检查机制的可见性、行动 特异性、最终结果可区分性、参考分布 适用时的理由以及结果读出标准。检查失败 引导我们选择或生成新的源图像，修改操作提示，或者 细化结果类别。当场景的模糊性无法解决时，我们就放弃它 可以在不改变正在评估的物理过程的情况下被删除。We review each candidate as a complete scenario before evaluating any model. The review checks mechanism visibility, action specificity, terminal-outcome distinguishability, reference-distribution justification when applicable, and the outcome-readout criteria. Failed checks lead us to select or generate a new source image, revise the action prompt, or refine the outcome categories. We discard a scenario when its ambiguity cannot be removed without changing the physical process being evaluated.

D.1 语言端诊断和干预Language-Side Diagnostics and Interventions

我们在两个界面评估语言：预测可能的结果，而无需 视频合成并向视频生成器请求特定结果。在 PE、GPT-5.5 从最初的观察和行动中预测可能的结果 无法访问参考发行版，然后编写生成器提示符 要求这个结果。在 Oracle PE 中，我们改为写入目标结果 直接进入生成器提示符。这些设置区分了两个错误： 预测错误的结果分布并且未能产生所要求的结果 视频中的结果。We evaluate language at two interfaces: predicting possible outcomes without video synthesis and requesting a specific outcome from a video generator. In PE, GPT-5.5 predicts a possible outcome from the initial observation and action without access to the reference distribution, then writes a generator prompt that requests this outcome. In Oracle PE, we instead write the target outcome directly into the generator prompt. These settings separate two errors: predicting the wrong outcome distribution and failing to produce a requested outcome in video.

For each of the 25 scenes in both tracks, we show a VLM the same source image and action prompt and ask it to describe one possible outcome, repeating the queryK=50K=50次。一个固定的 GPT-5.5 投影仪将这些自由形式的预测映射到特定场景 PAWBench 结果集，产生可评估的经验分布 违反场景的结果规范。times. A fixed GPT-5.5 projector maps these free-form predictions to the scene-specific PAWBench outcome set, yielding an empirical distribution that can be evaluated against the scene’s outcome specification.

只有映射到有效结果的响应才有助于此条件 分布。未映射或无效的响应反而计入场景 门，当超过 50 个查询中的 30 个时，场景就会失败。越过 场景、校准报告仅有效 TVD 和覆盖报告支持 恢复； SPR分别给出了25个场景中通过的分数。我们 重用两个轨道的冻结响应和预测，而不是 重新生成或重新投影它们。Only responses mapped to valid outcomes contribute to this conditional distribution. Unmapped or invalid responses instead count toward the scene gate, which fails a scene when they exceed 30 of the 50 queries. Over passing scenes, Calibration reports valid-only TVD and Coverage reports support recovery; SPR separately gives the fraction of the 25 scenes that pass. We reuse the frozen responses and projections for both tracks rather than regenerating or reprojecting them.

即时工程（PE）。Prompt Engineering(PE).对于每次推出，GPT-5.5 都会根据最初的结果预测一个可能的结果 观察和行动，然后编写一个生成器提示来请求该结果。 它既不接收参考分布也不接收目标结果 基准。For each rollout, GPT-5.5 predicts one possible outcome from the initial observation and action, then writes a generator prompt requesting that outcome. It receives neither the reference distribution nor a target outcome from the benchmark.

甲骨文PE。Oracle PE.对于 Oracle PE，我们在每个项目中手动指定一个 PAWBench 目标结果 发电机提示。对于 PAW 校准，我们转换参考概率 进入For Oracle PE, we manually specify one PAWBench target outcome in every generator prompt. For PAW-Calibration, we convert the reference probabilities intoK=50K=50目标 使用最大余数分配的请求。对于 PAW 覆盖范围，我们将 50 个请求在有效结果中尽可能均匀。我们确定性地 跨部署索引排列每个目标计划并重用相同的计划 对于每台发电机。在每个轨道的 25 个场景中，这给出了 2,500 每个生成器的目标条件推出。 PAWEval 读取最终结果，并且部署仅算作目标命中 当结果与请求相符时；不可读、无效、缺失和 不同的结果都是错过。然后我们询问一个单独的分布 通过将生成的校准 TVD 和覆盖范围与匹配的进行比较来提出问题 基地推出。目标命中率衡量生成器是否遵循 单独的结果请求，而 PAWBench 指标衡量的是总体结果 跨请求产生的分布。target requests using largest-remainder allocation. For PAW-Coverage, we divide the 50 requests as evenly as possible across the valid outcomes. We deterministically permute each target schedule across rollout indices and reuse the same schedule for every generator. Across the 25 scenes in each track, this gives 2,500 target-conditioned rollouts for each generator. PAWEval reads the terminal outcome, and a rollout counts as a target hit only when that outcome matches the request; unreadable, invalid, missing, and different outcomes are all misses. We then ask a separate distributional question by comparing the resulting Calibration TVD and Coverage with matched Base rollouts. Target-hit rate measures whether a generator follows an individual outcome request, whereas the PAWBench metrics measure the aggregate distribution produced across requests.

The results expose both errors: the language controller predicts the wrong outcome distribution, and the video generator often fails to produce a requested outcome. Language can change individual rollouts without reliably aligning their aggregate distribution.

D.2 耦合噪声采样Coupled Noise Sampling

扩散发生器的初始噪声通常是独立采样的 跨推出。 C2C 提出了一个更狭隘的问题：有限的画廊能否涵盖 当这些噪声耦合时，发电机的可访问未来更加均匀， 同时保留每次推出时看到的标准高斯边际？The initial noise of a diffusion generator is usually sampled independently across rollouts. C2C asks a narrower question: can a finite gallery cover the generator’s accessible futures more evenly when these noises are coupled, while preserving the standard-Gaussian marginal seen by every rollout?

由于 C2C 保留了每个初始噪声的边际分布，因此 不会改变生成器学习的一次性条件律。而是它 探测有限 IID 库是否错过了生成器可以实现的未来 已经意识到了。因此，耦合下覆盖范围的改善证明了 有限预算的探索，而不是学习一个更好校准的世界模型。Because C2C preserves the marginal distribution of every initial noise, it does not alter the generator’s learned one-rollout conditional law. It instead probes whether a finite IID gallery misses futures that the generator can already realize. Improved coverage under coupling is therefore evidence about finite-budget exploration, not about learning a better-calibrated world model.

D.3 培训-分发干预Training-Distribution Intervention

之前的干预措施使生成器保持不变。在这里我们反而问 训练数据中两个 future 的相对频率是否变为 生成器学习结果分布的一部分。我们仅改变 训练数据集的左右组合，在保持其大小的同时， 底层视频池、训练配方和推理请求已修复。The previous interventions leave the generator unchanged. Here we instead ask whether the relative frequency of two futures in the training data becomes part of the generator’s learned outcome distribution. We vary only the left–right composition of the training dataset, while holding its size, the underlying video pool, the training recipe, and the inference request fixed.

训练混合物。Training mixtures.从 100 个左倾视频和 100 个右倾视频开始，我们形成 5 个 训练数据集包含 2,000 个示例，左/右比例为Starting from 100 left-falling and 100 right-falling videos, we form five training datasets of 2,000 examples with left/right ratios of0/1000/100, 20/8020/80, 50/5050/50, 80/2080/20, 和, and100/0100/0。源视频统一重复 在每个方向内，因此数据集仅在相对频率上有所不同 的两个结果。三种内饰混合物保留了未来和 隔离它们的相对频率；两个端点作为边界 条件。每个训练示例都使用相同的中性运动提示。. Source videos are repeated uniformly within each direction, so the datasets differ only in the relative frequency of the two outcomes. The three interior mixtures retain both futures and isolate their relative frequency; the two endpoints serve as boundary conditions. Every training example uses the same neutral motion prompt.

LoRA 适配。LoRA adaptation.每种混合物均采用相同的 Wan2.2 I2V-A14B 基本模型，等级为 32 洛拉Each mixture adapts the same Wan2.2 I2V-A14B base model with rank-32 LoRA(Hu et al., 2022)。训练用途. Training uses×480832\!\times\!48049帧的剪辑， 学习率clips of 49 frames, a learning rate of10−410^{-4}，以及每位专家 2,000 次优化器更新；所有其他 配方选择在混合物之间共享。因为Wan2.2除噪 在高噪声和低噪声专家之间，我们为每种混合物训练配对适配器 并将其应用到相应的专家进行单位LoRA的推理 重量。这产生了五个适应模型；原Wan2.2型号提供 未调整的参考。, and 2,000 optimizer updates per expert; all other recipe choices are shared across mixtures. Because Wan2.2 divides denoising between high- and low-noise experts, we train paired adapters for each mixture and apply them to the corresponding experts at inference with unit LoRA weight. This produces five adapted models; the original Wan2.2 model provides an unadapted reference.

跨身体状态的评估。Evaluation across physical states. We evaluate Base and the five LoRA conditions on two pencil scenes using the same source image within each scene, a direction-neutral action prompt, and a matched set of K=50K=50 sampling seeds for every model–scene pair. The upright pencil has a 50/5050/50 left–right reference, whereas the initially left-leaning pencil has a 100/0100/0 reference. The five adapted models share one generation profile. The Base samples use the same scene, request, and seeds, but differ in output geometry and lack complete diffusion-profile metadata. We therefore draw the dose–response comparison from the LoRA models and use Base only to show the unadapted behavior. The two scenes test whether the intervention writes a shared directional prior or a distribution that changes with the observed physical state.

Across the three interior mixtures, conditional left-fall frequency increases in both scenes. Training composition therefore shifts mass among supported futures, but the experiment establishes neither exact ratio recovery nor scene-conditioned probability learning: both scenes respond similarly despite their different reference distributions.

Appendix E Qualitative Examples and Failure Cases

This appendix complements the aggregate PAWBench results with 13 case cards from distinct scenes. Each card shows a compact movie strip from one rollout, together with its scene, model, generation condition, instruction, and visible behavior. The examples illustrate how PAWEval reads terminal outcomes and why some visually plausible videos fail to complete the intended physical process. They provide qualitative evidence and do not enter any reported aggregate metric.

The set includes successful physical trials and typical failure modes: action-execution failures, object-continuity breaks, physically inconsistent trajectories, apparatus instability, and questionable but readable clips. These cards illustrate the aggregate patterns in Tab. 1, Fig. 11, Tab. 5.1, and Fig. 4.
